{{Top|leg}}
The '''kiloparsec''' was a unit of length measurement equivalent to one thousands [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Samarine Province]] was located seven kiloparsecs from [[Damualer Triac]].
